d:
Man sheravali ki mahima aur bhakti se paripurn anupam bhajan 'jholi bhar de bhar de meri mata sheravali' ko sunkar man jagdamba ki bhakti men lin ho jaeee |
Udit narayan ke mithe svaron men prastut is bhaktimay bhajan men bhakt apni pyari mata rani se sukh, samriddhi aur khushhali ka aashirvad mangte hain. man sheravali apne sabhi bhakton par apni kripa banae rakhen aur sabki manokamnaen purn karen.
Jay mata di!
Devi Bhajan: JHOLI BHARDE MATA SHERAWALI
Singer: Udit Narayan
Music Director: Ali Ghani
Lyricist: Shailendra Kumar Sharma
Feat. - Anmol
